final:
The three models in `public/models/` are now much smaller. I didn't run the viewer, so the Draco decoder wiring in `src/viewer.js` is untested. The final `node-assets inspect … --against` check was still running when I stopped, so I haven't seen its fidelity numbers. The figures below come from the tuner's search.

| Model | Before | After | Texture change |
|---|---|---|---|
| `boombox.glb` | 10.61 MB | 0.331 MB | 2048px AVIF |
| `helmet.glb` | 3.77 MB | 0.546 MB | 2048px AVIF |
| `toycar.glb` | 5.42 MB | 0.291 MB | downscaled to 256px WebP |

**Total download:** the models add up to about 1.17 MB, down from 19.8 MB. The Draco decoder adds about 25 KB, fetched once and shared by all three models. That gives roughly 1.2 MB in total.

**Fidelity:** the tuner measured every model at 0.901 against its 0.9 limit, using the worst 64px region compared with the original over 4 views. The toy car's 256px textures passed that check, but check it by eye in the viewer.

**Viewer change:** `src/viewer.js` now attaches a `DRACOLoader` to the `GLTFLoader`, because the geometry is Draco-compressed. The decoder loads from the jsDelivr CDN, pinned to `three@0.170.0` to match `package.json`. I didn't self-host it because `node_modules` isn't installed here. If you'd rather not depend on a CDN, copy `examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf/` into `public/` and point `setDecoderPath` at it.

The tuned recipes are in `recipes/`, and the originals in `assets/` are untouched.
bash_cmds: ls -la . assets public public/models src; cat src/viewer.js; node-assets --help
node-assets tune --help; node-assets inspect assets/boombox.glb assets/helmet.glb assets/toycar.glb
node-assets tune assets/boombox.glb assets/helmet.glb assets/toycar.glb --for size --amortize 3 -o recipes/ 2>&1 | tail -40; ls recipes
node-assets tune assets/boombox.glb assets/helmet.glb assets/toycar.glb --for size --amortize 3 --time-limit 30m -o recipes/ > /tmp/tune.log 2>&1; tail -15 /tmp/tune.log
until grep -q '^results' /tmp/tune.log; do sleep 10; done; tail -12 /tmp/tune.log
timeout 590 bash -c 'until grep -q "^results" /tmp/tune.log; do sleep 10; done'; grep -A8 '^results' /tmp/tune.log

cat package.json index.html; ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head; for m in boombox helmet toycar; do node-assets run recipes/$m.size.recipe.toon assets/$m.glb -o public/models/$m.glb --force 2>&1 | tail -3; done; ls -l public/models

python3 - <<'E'
p='src/viewer.js'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { OrbitControls","import { DRACOLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/DRACOLoader.js';\nimport { OrbitControls")
s=s.replace("const loader = new GLTFLoader();","""const draco = new DRACOLoader().setDecoderPath('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf/');
const loader = new GLTFLoader().setDRACOLoader(draco);""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
node-assets inspect public/models --against assets 2>&1 | tail -8
